name: GitLab
shortDescription: Visual no-code builder for static websites with GitLab sign-in: sites are stored in GitLab repositories and published to GitLab Pages.

alerts.message: Silex needs a GitLab OAuth application. Create one on your GitLab instance with the redirect URI https://<your domain>/api/connector/login/callback and the scopes api, write_repository and read_user, then set GITLAB_CLIENT_ID and GITLAB_CLIENT_SECRET to its application ID and secret and redeploy. For a self-managed GitLab, also change GITLAB_DOMAIN.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
